item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - DJ Meredith Marks - Today's Hits November 2025 (DJ Mix) Apple Music
item.description:
As the title says, it would be greatly appreciated if there was a way to acquire the Lossless audio of 'DJ Meredith Marks - Today's Hits November 2025 (DJ Mix)'. It's on Apple Music.

And yes, this is a serious post. Yes, she is a housewife on the Real Housewives of Salt Lake City.. and yes she is a DJ, mother, jewelry designer, caviar brand owner, fashion retailer, lawyer, water bender (watch the show for that one).. the list goes on!

This mix consist of hits mixed with her catchphrases and cameos by other housewives, such as Luanne de Lesseps' iconic 'I hope you keep on serving cunt'!
